title: Tracking area update request message (for N1 mode only)

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to construct a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message for inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode for security verification by the MME.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Message created by EMM upon request from 5GMM, included in REGISTRATION REQUEST message for N1 mode inter-system change.

entities.name: EPS update type
entities.description: Mandatory IE in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message that must be set to 'TA updating'.

entities.name: NAS Key Set Identifier
entities.description: Mandatory IE containing eKSI (KSIASME or KSISGSN) for security context.

entities.name: Old GUTI
entities.description: Mandatory IE containing the associated GUTI.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
entities.description: Substate where UE remains if tracking area updating procedure is not initiated during inter-system change.

entities.name: Integrity protection with EPS security context
entities.description: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message must be integrity protected using current EPS security context with uplink NAS COUNT increased by one.

relations.description: Tracking area updating procedure constructs the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message contains mandatory EPS update type IE.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message contains mandatory NAS Key Set Identifier IE.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message contains mandatory Old GUTI IE.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message must be integrity protected with EPS security context.
If UE is in EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state, tracking area updating procedure is not initiated.
